Source: GH #2335 (ISS-1039, Q-1021) adoption scope. PRECONDITION TO CHECK FIRST (ORDERING: satisfied, PR #2334 merged as 3eb72f99 on 2026-10-07; re-verify with grep as below): the two tests named 'KNOWN LIMITATION (ISS-1008 AC3 unmet)' are in test/letflow/scripts/swiftroute_decision_forms_fixture_test.exs on PR #2334 (branch fix/swiftroute-lane-Q-993-990-994, Q-990 / GH #2277). When this entry was drafted (2026-10-07) PR #2334 was OPEN and NOT merged, and `grep -rn 'KNOWN LIMITATION' test` on main returned nothing, so on main the swiftroute definition is test/fixtures/qa/swiftroute_process_definition.json at v1.4 without decision forms. ELIXIR-DEV first verifies on the working branch whether #2334 has merged (grep and git log, quoted). If it has not, this entry stops and reports to ORCH as blocked on #2334; it does not recreate the v1.5 forms itself.
BUILDS: 1. Each of the following TWELVE HUMAN_TASK nodes declares
   required_outputs naming the key its outgoing edges read (ids and
   keys verified against the fixtures on 2026-10-07; ELIXIR-DEV
   re-verifies them on the working branch):
   swiftroute (test/fixtures/qa/swiftroute_process_definition.json,
   keys as on PR #2334's v1.5 forms):
     a. ops-review: ops_decision
     b. ceo-approval: ceo_decision
   meridian loan origination
   (test/fixtures/qa/meridian_loan_origination_process_definition.json):
     c. l1-approval: l1_decision
     d. l2-approval: l2_decision
     e. escalate-l2-approval-to-ceo: l2_decision (the D-ESC task for
        l2-approval, role role-ceo; meridian has no node named
        ceo-approval)
     f. kyc-manual-review: kyc_outcome (read by the eligibility-gate
        edge e15-kyc-cleared)
   vortex production order release
   (test/fixtures/qa/vortex_production_order_release_process_definition.json):
     g. capacity-review: capacity_decision
     h. escalate-to-ceo: capacity_decision
     i. budget-approval: budget_decision
     j. escalate-budget-approval-to-ceo: budget_decision
   vortex supplier quality deviation
   (test/fixtures/qa/vortex_supplier_quality_deviation_process_definition.json):
     k. severity-classification: severity (read downstream by the
        severity-routing edges e6-e8; this node has no form_schema,
        so severity is not a form property and REQ-461 check 3 can
        never fire for it; check 2 is satisfied by the existing
        severity variable_schema)
     l. escalate-severity-classification-to-ceo: severity (the D-ESC
        task for severity-classification; same required_outputs key
        as its source node, per REQ-459 design section 9 decision 1;
        ORCH DECISION 2026-10-07: a missing value would otherwise
        fall through to default-critical)
   Deliberately NOT in this list (see open_questions): meridian
   credit-memo-review / credit-memo-escalation-review (credit_decision),
   risk-assessment / risk-assessment-escalation-review (risk_rating),
   committee-vote-cro / -director / -ceo, the regulatory review,
   false-positive (vortex supplier quality deviation; read by
   false-positive-check, submitted by the same
   severity-classification task: not a decision key of this batch,
   left for a later adoption pass) and the swiftroute incident
   definition. If the run finds an edge reading a key of any of
   these it reports it to ORCH.
2. Every adopted key has a variable_schema (REQ-461 check 2, a
   VIOLATION at validate and activate:
   :required_output_without_variable_schema) in the
   definition and in the seed scripts under scripts/, so the
   fixture, the seed and the definition agree.
3. The two KNOWN LIMITATION tests (ops-review and ceo-approval completed
   with the decision key OMITTED) are replaced by assertions of the
   new behaviour: 422 (code output_refused, missing_keys naming the
   key), task still open, instance unchanged, and a retry with a
   valid decision completes and routes. REQ-461's check 3 is a
   permanent WARNING (REQ-459 design section 1.4, D-4); there is NO
   severity switch in this entry. Warnings that remain for the
   deliberately unadopted keys (see the NOT-in-list paragraph) are
   listed per definition in the run report and reported to ORCH.
4. Each changed definition's version is incremented by one minor step
   from the version found on the working branch at the start (not a
   number written in this entry; swiftroute is v1.5 on main after PR
   #2334, other definitions as found) and its description says why, as the v1.5 swiftroute
   line does. REQ-465 and REQ-466 then increment again from whatever
   this entry leaves, so numbering is sequential and read, never
   assumed.
requirement_acceptance_criteria: the run report quotes the check of PR #2334 (merged or not); if not merged the entry reports blocked and changes nothing (git diff empty)

for each of the twelve nodes a through l in BUILDS item 1 a test completes it with the decision key omitted and asserts 422 naming that key, task still open, instance unchanged, then completes it with a valid value and asserts the route taken: twelve tests, named by node id, and the run report lists the twelve test names. REQ-461 check 3 is vacuous for the vortex nodes g through l (no form_schema, so no form-produced key) and proves nothing there; the 422 tests are the evidence

the two former KNOWN LIMITATION tests no longer exist (grep 'KNOWN LIMITATION' test returns nothing for them) and their replacements assert 422, not the former fail-closed route; the former assertion text is quoted in the run report

every shipped definition changed by this entry passes the validator with status OK (no violation), and REQ-461 check 3 emits no decision_key_not_required: warning for any of the twelve adopted nodes (a through l); warnings that remain for the deliberately unadopted keys (meridian credit_decision, risk_rating, committee votes, regulatory review) are expected, are counted and listed per definition in the run report, and are reported to ORCH
no definition outside the three verticals and no HUMAN_TASK node whose decision key is not read by a conditional edge at or downstream of it is changed (git diff --stat quoted)
SECURITY-REVIEWER verdict recorded (mandatory for adoption that changes what a completion may omit on a tenant-data path)

mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix format --check-formatted, scoped mix test over test/letflow/scripts and test/letflow/engine files naming the changed definitions, and mix letflow.check_boundaries pass, real output quoted
open_questions: Escalation tasks of D-ESC (for example escalate-l2-approval-to-ceo, escalate-to-ceo) are HUMAN_TASKs that take the same decision. DECIDED by REQ-459 design section 9 (decision 1): no inheritance; each escalation node declares the same required_outputs as the node it replaces, explicitly, because an omitted decision on an escalation task has the same silent fail-closed effect. Items e, h, j and l declare them.

Start-form required instance-start variables (declared_value) are out of scope (see REQ-460 open_questions). The ISS-1008 acceptance line 'The declared value is a required start field' stays unmet by this entry and is reported to ORCH.

Sizing: twelve nodes across four definitions in one entry. If ELIXIR-DEV finds the work exceeds one turn it adopts swiftroute and replaces the KNOWN LIMITATION tests first and reports the remaining verticals to ORCH for a split, not a partial silent pass.

Out-of-list decision keys (meridian credit_decision, risk_rating and the three committee votes; regulatory review). They are read by edges but are not named in GH #2335's adoption list. Default: not adopted here; ORCH decides whether a follow-up entry adopts them.
